warmth: The fire kept me warm all night.
Cold camp, warm fire. Just right.
privacy: A quiet corner, exactly what I needed.
company: Good company at the next pad.
Made a friend by the fire.
nature: Woke up to birdsong and green.
The flowers by my tent made my morning.
light: The lanterns made camp feel alive.
Lit paths, warm light — felt safe all night.
music: Songs by the fire. I stayed up too late.
Someone played guitar. Best night on the trail.
dog: Your dog visited my tent. Best part of the stay.
The camp dog slept by my pad. Ten stars.
play: The kids didn't want to leave.
They played until the stars came out.
water: Slept to the sound of the river.
Cast a line at dawn. Caught breakfast.
view: That view. I'd pay double for it.
Sat outside until dark just watching the valley.
stars: Counted constellations until I fell asleep.
favourite: They cooked my favourite. I'm coming back.
You remembered what I like. That means a lot.
comfort: Best sleep I've had on the trail.
A real bed. My back thanks you.
rain: Rained all night and the pad leaked.
light_bad: The lantern outside my tent stayed lit all night.
dog_bad: Not a dog person. The dog found me anyway.
The dog kept sniffing around my tent.
no_meal: No dinner? The fire smelled nice at least.
bare: A thin mat on hard ground.
Slept on roots. Literally on them.
neutral: A fine night under the trees.
